s: 4 hours ago - An active ETF is simply an active strategy held within the ETF wrapper. An active strategy is one where a portfolio manager actively picks which assets to buy and sell into a fund, whereas a passive strategy mirrors an index like the FTSE 100 or the S&P 500.
